name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €90/MWh, 14% lower on the week but above the €70 Alert line
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €89.6/MWh on 5 Nov, 14% lower on the week but above the €70 Alert line and 47% higher over three months (Yahoo Finance). Hormuz, the route for Qatari LNG, remained largely shut, with Iran reporting three tankers damaged there on 5 Nov (Nation Thailand).
for_you: Household energy bills and industrial costs stay exposed to Qatari LNG supply through Hormuz.

sources.title: Nation Thailand — Iran reports three tankers damaged in Hormuz

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
